minutes.headline: Planning Board planned joint candidate interviews and heard a resident oppose rezoning; only vote was adjournment.
minutes.summary: The board discussed coordinating candidate interviews with the Selectmen, proofreading a long draft document, and the ongoing use table and bylaw rewrite. A resident objected to possible future rezoning, and the director said the town is about 120 units short of the 10% affordable housing level. The chair discussed priorities and communication among land use boards; the only vote was adjournment.

public_comment.topic: Resident asked whether the board plans to rezone areas of town, said he was concerned after the architectural preservation district included his house, and asked for significant public input before any rezoning.

budget_items.what_was_said: The town received a state grant for electronic permitting and is looking at vendors.

decisions.decision: Staff will take the board's views on joint interviews back to the Board of Selectmen; the next meeting will settle the schedule and draft questions will be circulated.
Members will review the draft document one chunk at a time and mark it up, with input from Ken on bylaw interpretation.
The 26th joint meeting is off; the 10th likely covers applications and the cell tower; a possible joint meeting on July 18.
A priority list will be added to the ongoing items for later discussion.
